user.title: Zabbix alerts
user.description:
Sets up Zabbix to notify Home Assistant the moment a problem starts, resolves or is updated, and keeps that setup up to date. Turn on **Configure → Alerts** in the Zabbix integration first.

This creates a webhook media type, a user, a user group (with read access to all host groups) and a trigger action in Zabbix. Removing this integration deletes them again. It needs an API token of a Zabbix **Super admin**.
